items.name: appointment-calendar
items.title: Appointment Calendar
items.description: Clinic scheduling calendar with day, week and month views, provider columns, overlap layout and status colors.

items.name: appointment-slot-picker
items.title: Appointment Slot Picker
items.description: Patient self-booking picker: choose a day, then an available time grouped by morning, afternoon and evening.

items.name: clinical-status-badge
items.title: Clinical Status Badge
items.description: Color-coded status pill for results and observations: normal, borderline, abnormal, critical.

items.name: vital-signs
items.title: Vital Signs
items.description: Vital sign cards with reference ranges, automatic status classification and trend sparklines.

items.name: medication-list
items.title: Medication List
items.description: Active medication list with dose, route, frequency, PRN and high-alert flags.

items.name: lab-results
items.title: Lab Results
items.description: Results-review table grouped into collapsible panels, with FHIR interpretation flags, reference ranges, change since the previous result, and a trend chart for each result.

items.name: vitals-chart
items.title: Vitals Chart
items.description: Trend chart of vital signs over time, with a shaded normal band and dots coloured by clinical status, like EHR flowsheet graphs and NEWS2 charts.

items.name: medication-form
items.title: Medication Form
items.description: Structured medication order entry (sig builder) with drug search, quick-pick presets, PRN, high-alert warning and a live plain-language sig preview.

items.name: clinical-timeline
items.title: Clinical Timeline
items.description: Chronological patient activity feed (visits, labs, imaging, medications, immunizations, messages) with type filters, search, day or month grouping and load more.

items.name: allergy-list
items.title: Allergy List
items.description: View and edit allergies and intolerances (FHIR AllergyIntolerance) with criticality, reactions, verification, no-known-allergies handling and a built-in entry form.

items.name: problem-list
items.title: Problem List
items.description: Patient problem list (FHIR Condition) with Active/Resolved/All filters, coded diagnoses, async code search and resolve/reactivate actions.

items.name: body-map
items.title: Body Map
items.description: Interactive human anatomy map for pinpointing where the problem is: ~100 fine regions (eyes, ears, nose, fingers, abdominal regions…), male and female figures, zoomable close-ups of the face, hands and feet, heat-map intensity and selection chips.

items.name: pain-scale
items.title: Pain Scale
items.description: 0–10 Numeric Rating Scale with color bands, face descriptors and full keyboard support.

items.name: vitals-form
items.title: Vitals Form
items.description: Vital signs entry with units, metric/imperial toggle, live status, plausibility checks and BMI.

items.name: patient-header
items.title: Patient Header
items.description: Patient banner with demographics, copyable MRN, allergy chips and safety flags.

items.name: dental-chart
items.title: Dental Chart
items.description: Odontogram for dental charting: permanent, primary or mixed dentition, FDI / Universal / Palmer numbering, 5-surface diagrams, existing vs planned treatment and an ADA-style findings summary.

items.name: lesion-map
items.title: Lesion Map
items.description: Skin lesion and wound documentation map: numbered pins at exact positions on the front/back body, auto-detected region, status-coloured tracking and an editor.

items.name: early-warning-score
items.title: Early Warning Score
items.description: NEWS2 calculator with per-parameter sub-scores, red-score detection, clinical risk band and RCP monitoring/response guidance.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Scored patient questionnaire with PHQ-9 and GAD-7 built in: radio-group items, live progress, severity bands, and item-level safety flags.

items.name: glasgow-coma-scale
items.title: Glasgow Coma Scale
items.description: Structured GCS assessment with eye, verbal and motor radiogroups, not-testable handling, severity band and optional GCS-P.

items.name: fall-risk-score
items.title: Fall Risk Score
items.description: Morse Fall Scale form with live total, configurable risk thresholds and an intervention checklist per risk level.

items.name: faces-pain-scale
items.title: Faces Pain Scale
items.description: Paediatric self-report pain scale: six original faces scored 0–10 in steps of 2, with child-friendly labels, colour ramp and radio-group keyboard support.

items.name: growth-chart
items.title: Growth Chart
items.description: Paediatric weight- and length-for-age chart with WHO percentile curves (0–24 months), plotted measurements, percentile and z-score tooltips, and flags outside the 3rd–97th percentiles.

items.name: fluid-balance
items.title: Fluid Balance
items.description: Hourly intake and output (I&O) flowsheet with shift subtotals, 24 h totals, running balance and a weight-based urine output check.

items.name: medication-administration-record
items.title: Medication Administration Record
items.description: eMAR grid of medication orders by day and scheduled time, with given, held, refused, missed, due and overdue status, PRN doses, high-alert flags and a documentation dialog.

items.name: clinic-dashboard
items.title: Clinic Dashboard
items.description: Sidebar dashboard with KPIs, a provider day schedule, waiting room triage and new results.

items.name: patient-chart
items.title: Patient Chart
items.description: Patient chart: banner, vitals, editable problem list and allergies, lab results with trends, medication orders, timeline and a SOAP note.

items.name: appointment-booking
items.title: Appointment Booking
items.description: Three-step patient self-booking flow: visit type, time slot, details and confirmation.

items.name: symptom-report
items.title: Symptom Report
items.description: Patients mark affected areas on a body map, rate each one, and describe their symptoms.

items.name: patient-intake
items.title: Patient Intake Form
items.description: New-patient intake: demographics, contacts, insurance, history, medications, allergies, body map and consent.

items.name: theme-teal
items.title: Teal theme
items.description: Teal primary, ring and chart colours.

items.name: theme-blue
items.title: Blue theme
items.description: Blue primary, ring and chart colours.

items.name: theme-violet
items.title: Violet theme
items.description: Violet primary, ring and chart colours.

items.name: theme-rose

items.description: Rose primary, ring and chart colours.

items.name: theme-orange
items.title: Orange theme
items.description: Orange primary, ring and chart colours.

items.name: theme-green
items.title: Green theme
items.description: Green primary, ring and chart colours.

items.name: theme-base
items.title: Mono theme
items.description: Mono primary, ring and chart colours.

items.name: clinical-standard
items.title: Standard clinical colours
items.description: Green, amber, orange and red, as used in most early-warning charts.

items.name: clinical-colorblind
items.title: Colour-blind safe clinical colours
items.description: Blue, yellow, orange and magenta. Distinct under red–green colour blindness.

items.name: clinical-muted
items.title: Muted clinical colours
items.description: Lower-chroma tones for calm, low-stimulus interfaces.
